articleTitle: Direct-Detection Technologies for Intra- and Inter-Data Center Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We remind you that a tutorial is preferably an instructional lesson made for a broad audience to discover a field Your talk should be presented at a level that is understandable to a diverse audience of non-specialists.

articleTitle: Comparison of Coherent and IMDD Transceivers for Intra Datacenter Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluated the performance of 400G coherent and IMDD transceivers for intra-datacenter interconnects, and showed that coherent transceivers can achieve a higher power budget with comparable ASIC power consumption.

articleTitle: Coupled-Core Transmission Over 7-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show combined SDM/WDM transmission over a novel 7-core coupled-core fiber over distances up to 12100 km for QPSK and 4400 km for 16QAM signals, with corresponding spectral efficiency of 21 bit/s/Hz and 42 bit/s/Hz. The measurements show that such a 7-core fiber clearly outperforms an equivalent single-mode fiber resulting in more than 7 times the capacity.

articleTitle: Proactive Dynamic Network Slicing with Deep Learning Based Short-Term Traffic Prediction for 5G Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a proactive dynamic network slicing scheme that utilizes a deep-learning based short-term traffic prediction approach for 5G transport networks. The demonstration shows utilization efficiency improvement from 46.33% to 71.53% under the evaluated scenario.

articleTitle: 192-Gbaud Signal Generation using Ultra-Broadband Optical Frontend Module Integrated with Bandwidth Multiplexing Function
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose ultra-broadband optical frontend module consisting of an IQ-modulator, driver ICs, and bandwidth multiplexers. 192-GBaud QPSK and 160-GBaud 8QAM signals were successfully generated by using the 80-GHz frontend module based on in-house InP technology.

articleTitle: Beyond 1Tb/s Datacenter Interconnect Technology: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss challenges and solutions for beyond 1Tb/s intra-datacenter bandwidth scaling, with a focus on the FlexPAM-based direct detection and the baud-rate DSP enabled coherent detection.

articleTitle: First Field Trial of Sensing Vehicle Speed, Density, and Road Conditions by using Fiber Carrying High Speed Data
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate detection of vehicle speed, density, and road conditions using deployed fiber carrying high-speed data transmission, and prove carriers' large-scale fiber infrastructures can also be used as ubiquitous sensing networks.

articleTitle: 255-Gbps PAM-8 Transmission under 20-GHz Bandwidth Limitation using NL-MLSE Based on Volterra Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 85-Gbaud PAM-8 transmission with BER below HD-FEC limit under 20-GHz bandwidth limitation is achieved applying NL-MLSE based on Volterra filter. NL-MLSE also achieves 3.84-Tbps O-band transmission using 4-λ LAN-WDM and SDM over 2-km 4-core fiber.

articleTitle: P4 In-Band Telemetry (INT) for Latency-Aware VNF in Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A first demonstration of P4-based virtual network function (VNF) for latency-critical services is presented. The VNF exploits P4 In-band telemetry to dynamically enforce per-packet QoS priority according to cumulated latency performance.

articleTitle: 80-Channel WDM-MDM Transmission Over 50-km Ring-Core Fiber using a Compact OAM DEMUX and Modular 4×4 MIMO Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 8-OAM modes each carrying 10 wavelengths with 2.56-Tbit/s aggregated capacity and 10.24-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency have been transmitted over 50-km specially designed ring-core fiber, using a compact OAM mode sorter and only modular 4×4 MIMO equalization.

articleTitle: 32 GBd 16QAM Wireless Transmission in the 300 GHz Band using a PIN Diode for THz Upconversion
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate THz wireless transmission of 32 GBd QPSK and 16QAM signals using a broadband PIN photodiode. Using an electronic THz receiver operating at 300 GHz, error-free transmission is achieved at 100 Gb/s net rate.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an Analogue Domain Processing IC for Carrier Phase Recovery and Compensation in Coherent Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a carrier phase recovery and compensation technique for low power coherent optical interconnects. Experimental results from an analogue processing IC developed for this purpose for QPSK and 16-QAM signals have been presented.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for BBU Placement and Routing in C-RAN
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based policy for BBU placement and routing in C-RAN. The simulation results show DRL-based policy reaches the near-optimal performance with a significantly reduced computing time.

articleTitle: Probabilistically Shaped 256-QAM-OFDM Transmission in Underwater Wireless Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated PS-256-QAM-OFDM for 35m underwater-wireless-optical-communication (UWOC) system. Compared with bit-power loading scheme, 27.8% capacity improvement is achieved. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time to employ PS-QAM in UWOC.

articleTitle: Ultrawide Bandwidth Hollow Core Fiber for Interband Short Reach Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a Nested Antiresonant Nodeless hollow-core Fiber with 700nm bandwidth (1240-1940nm) and a minimum loss of 6.6dB/km at 1550nm. Penalty-free 100-Gb/s PAM4 data transmission from O- to L-band is demonstrated over ~1km of fiber.

articleTitle: 40-Gbit/s Visible Light Communication using Polarization-Multiplexed R/G/B Laser Diodes with 2-m Free-Space Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a recorded 40.665-Gbit/s visible-light-communication (VLC) system using polarization multiplexed red/green/blue (R/G/B) laser-diodes (LDs) with 2-m free-space transmission. Bit-and-power-loading orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexed (OFDM) signal is employed.

articleTitle: Transmission Systems with Constant Output Power Amplifiers at Low SNR Values: A Generalized Droop Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a unified model of signal impairment aggregation with fixed-power amplifiers which captures ASE noise accumulation and its combination with nonlinearities. We numerically show discrepancies with AWGN-like models adapted to fixed-gain amplifiers at low SNR values.

articleTitle: Field Test of Installed High-Density Optical Fiber Cable with Multi-Core Fibers toward Practical Deployment
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A field trial of high-density 0.92-km 200-fiber cable with 5-core fibers (5CFs) was conducted for reliability tests. No degradation of cable attenuation of 5CFs was observed even after installation into underground conduits and aerial area.

articleTitle: Identification of Soft Failures in Optical Links using Low Complexity Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate one-class SVM employing readily available receiver side DSP features to detect soft link failures. The technique was able to detect inferior lasers, faulty ROADMs, OSNR degradation and inter-channel interference with <;4% classification error.

articleTitle: 400G and Beyond: Coherent Evolution to High-Capacity Inter Data Center Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Coherent data transmission applications to the data center interconnect space are presented. We discuss methods of increasing the data rate beyond 400Gb/s, and the improvements in signal-to-noise ratio requirements when Ethernet optimized transport is used.

articleTitle: Intent Based Network Operations
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Intent Based Networking defines high level policies (what) for the network, translated to configuration (how) by underling systems. An overview is given then focus goes to ONOS helping network automation through intents. Finally challenges are discussed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Noise Monitoring in Coherent Systems using Amplitude Modulation Pilot Tone and Zero-Power Gap
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new method to monitor fiber nonlinear noise power using amplitude modulation pilot-tone and zero-power gap. The direct nonlinear noise monitoring was verified experimentally in multi-channel transmission over a 600-km SSFM link.

articleTitle: Fault Management Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) brings many benefits for network operation. In this paper, basic ML concepts and its integration into existing network control and management planes are reviewed. Case studies covering fault management are illustrated.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for QoT Estimation of Unseen Optical Network States
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We apply deep graph convolutional neural networks for Quality-of-Transmission estimation of unseen network states capturing, apart from other important impairments, the inter-core crosstalk that is prominent in optical networks operating with multicore fibers.

articleTitle: Automated Alignment Between Channel and Filter Cascade
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new and cost-efficient method based on receiver-side spectrum monitoring to mitigate filter impairments. We experimentally demonstrated up to 3dB-reduction in filter penalties for 32GBd PDM-QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Sparse Volterra Nonlinear Equalizer by Employing Pruning Algorithm for High-Speed PAM-4 850-nm VCSEL Optical Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A pruned Volterra equalizer that reduces computational complexity by up to 85.2% in 112-Gbps PAM-4 optical interconnects is proposed. The BER performance is competitive with LASSO-based Volterra equalizers, and training time is twice as fast.

articleTitle: Demonstration of ONU Activation for In-Service TDM-PON Allowing Uninterrupted Low-Latency Transport Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an upstream-traffic-disruption-free ONU activation method enabling low-latency services over TDM-PON. We demonstrate ranging using only 5-μs-long empty window independent from fiber length, a significant improvement over 250/450-μs quiet windows required in conventional ranging.

articleTitle: Demonstration of High Precision 3D Indoor Positioning System Based on Two-Layer Ann Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a high precision 3D indoor visible light positioning system utilizing two-layer machine learning technique. The measured average positioning resolution of <;1cm in an unit volume of 0.9 × 1 × 0.4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: 93-GHz Signal Beam Steering with True Time Delayed Integrated Optical Beamforming Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 93-GHz beam steering experiment based on a 1 × 4 phased array antenna was demonstrated, achieving beam steering angles of -51°, ±34°, ±17° and 0°. An integrated optical beamforming network chip with true time delays was employed.

articleTitle: Demystifying Transceiver and Line Characterization Metrics: A Tutorial
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This tutorial will provide a broad overview of the following topics Review Optical Line Metrics Review Transceiver Metrics Explore Basic Information Theory.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Uncoupled Two-Core Fiber for Power Efficient Practical Submarine Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realized 125-μm-cladding 2-core fiber with 0.162-dB/km attenuation, lowest-ever among uncoupled multi-core fibers, and effective areas of 112μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. It can enable 1.34-times higher capacity without increasing power consumption, compared with a state-of-the-art submarine single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength Optical Transceivers Integrated on Node (MOTION)
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on efforts to develop a high speed, low cost, low energy chip scale optical module for co-packaging on a first-level organic substrate for HPC and Data Center applications.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 260-Gb/s Single-Lane EML-Based PS-PAM-8 IM/DD for Datacenter Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated single-lane EML-based IM/DD 106-Gbaud PAM-4 and PS-PAM-8 signals transmission over 1-km NZDSF based on Pre-EQ and clipping technique. 260-Gb/s PS-PAM-8 signal transmission can be achieved.

articleTitle: Up to Single Lane 200G Optical Interconnects with Silicon Photonic Modulator
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-high speed optical interconnects with record single lane bit rates of 200Gb/s (80Gbaud) PAM-6 and 176Gb/s (88Gbaud) PAM-4 based on conventional silicon photonic modulator with Mach-Zehnder structure.

articleTitle: Ultra-High Bandwidth InP IQ Modulator for Beyond 100-GBd Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an ultra-high bandwidth IQ modulator with an electro-optic bandwidth of around 80 GHz at a half-wave voltage of 1.5 V, which is a promising modulator for beyond 100-GBd transmission.

articleTitle: Improved Dispersion Tolerance for 50G-PON Downstream Transmission via Receiver-Side Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally show that the dispersion penalty of a 50-Gb/s NRZ signal under 85-ps/nm dispersion can be reduced to below 1 dB via receiver-side equalization, showing the promise of supporting 50G-PON downstream transmission over 20-km SSMF at the 1342-nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Outage Probability Due to Intercore Crosstalk in Weakly-Coupled MCF Systems with OOK Signaling
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The outage induced by intercore-crosstalk in multicore-fiber systems employing on-off-keying signaling is theoretically and experimentally characterized. It is shown that a crosstalk level below -16 dB is required to obtain an outage probability below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: 50G BPSK, 100G SP-QPSK, 200G 8QAM, 400G 64QAM Ultra Long Single Span Unrepeatered Transmission Over 670.64km, 653.35km, 601.93km and 502.13km Respectively
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrates record single-carrier 50Gb/s, 100Gb/s, 200Gb/s and 400Gb/s unrepeatered transmission over 670.64km, 653.35km, 601.93km and 502.13km respectively. Using optimized Raman amplifiers, cascaded RGUs, ultra low-loss & 130-μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> fibers, and optimal modulation format.

articleTitle: Optical Strategies for Economical Next Generation 50 and 100G PON
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An overview of optical strategies for economical next-generation 50 and 100G PON is given.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Adaptive Equalizer for Digital Coherent Short-Reach Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel adaptive equalization algorithm for short-reach digital coherent systems targeting intra-datacenter applications. Its performance is similar to conventional method, while the number of real multipliers is reduced by ~65%.

articleTitle: A 300mm CMOS-Compatible PECVD Silicon Nitride Platform for Integrated Photonics with Low Loss and Low Process Induced Phase Variation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low loss PECVD silicon nitride waveguides at 905 nm (0.2 dB/cm) and 532 nm (1.36 dB/cm) wavelengths are reported. Efficacy of phase variation measurements for identifying process conditions for optical phased array fabrication is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Autonomous Network Diagnosis with AI
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose novel autonomous network diagnosis platform. We will discuss some requirements from network operators toward such direction and how to meet such requirements with novel mechanisms. We also present PoC demonstration.

articleTitle: Towards Low Carrier-to-Signal Power Ratio for Kramers-Kronig Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel scheme to relax the requirement of high carrier-to-signal power ratio for Kramers-Kronig receiver. By adopting low carrier-to-signal power ratios, we obtain optical signal-to-noise ratio improvement of up to 1.9 dB.

articleTitle: Laser Eyes for Driverless Cars: The Road to Automotive LIDAR
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Automotive LIDAR is one of the primary sensors for fully autonomous vehicles, and the performance requirements of these sensors places challenges on the optical technologies used in the device. We analyze the requirements for automotive LIDAR and then suggest a novel taxonomy of classifying different beamsteering methods.

articleTitle: TeraPHY: A High-Density Electronic-Photonic Chiplet for Optical I/O from a Multi-Chip Module
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this work, we provide an overview of System-in-Package (SiP) integration of an electronic-photonic chiplet fabricated in a commercial CMOS foundry. Assembly considerations, including co-packaging in a standard multi-chip module (MCM) package with a System-on-Chip (SoC), thermals, and fiber attach will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Coherent Versus Kramers-Kronig Transceivers in Metro Applications: A Power Consumption Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We estimate power consumption of coherent and Kramers-Kronig (KK) transceivers with various configurations. We show that KK transceivers consume comparable power with coherent transceiver, but the upsampling-free KK transceiver consumes 33% less power than coherent one.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Machine Learning Enhanced DSP for DP-64QAM Coherent Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to improve DSP for coherent-signal recovery with distributed multi-stage machine-learning algorithms. Experiments demonstrate more-than-3-dB and 1-dB improvements in OSNR sensitivities for 40-GBd and 60-GBd DP-64QAM at BER thresholds of 4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> and L6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> respectively.

articleTitle: Growing Impact of Optical Filtering in Future WDM Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Whereas carriers faster than 60 GBaud will soon be deployed in the elastic WDM networks, we examine how 75 GHz-wide channel spacing and filtering impact their performance.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Raman Scattering Effects in Multicore Fibers: Impact on Coexistence of Quantum and Classical Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure spontaneous Raman scattering (SRS) effects in C-band and observe trench-assisted MCF is robust to SRS noise, making it possible to run quantum channels in the neighboring and/or the same core as data channels.

articleTitle: On the Analysis and Emulation of Nonlinear Component Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present theoretical background and implementation considerations of Volterra series based nonlinear component models. We demonstrate the advantage of combining frequency and time domain representations and present an efficient way to find high-order filter taps.

articleTitle: Reduction in Power Consumption in Multi-Core Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report advances in low power consumption multi-core amplifiers. We namely show recent advances concerning core pumping, cladding pumping and hybrid pumping technologies for power efficient optical amplification with erbium doped multi-core fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 5G Trial Service in 28 GHz Millimeter Wave using IFoF-Based Analog Distributed Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the successful demonstration of 5G trial service using IFoF-based analog DAS during Pyeongchang Winter Olympics. 5G connected car, one of the 5G key services, is successfully demonstrated through IFoF-based DAS in Pyeongchang area.

articleTitle: Error-Free 100Gbps PAM-4 Transmission Over 100m OM5 MMF using 1060nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate error-free (BER <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>) rates beyond 100Gbps over 100m OM5 using unpackaged 1060nm VCSELs. Power penalties of PAM-2/PAM-4 are examined demonstrating OM5 fiber capacity to support wavelengths to 1060nm with only transmitter equalization.

articleTitle: System Performance Evaluation of a Nanoseconds Modular Photonic Integrated WDM WSS for Optical Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The system performance of a photonic integrated WDM wavelength selective switch is assessed with 10, 20 and 40Gb/s NRZ-OOK. Results show lossless operation, limited penalty for 8 WDM channels and > 8dB power dynamic range.

articleTitle: Photonic-Assisted Modulation Classification for RF Signals using Probabilistic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photonic-assisted modulation classification for RF signals using PNN is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The approach achieves >97% classification accuracy at -1~15 SNR with 160 training samples for each SNR value and modulation format.

articleTitle: Power Control Strategies in C+L Optical Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Following the LOGO paradigm, we propose and test frequency-dependent power control strategies and show that 50% pre-tilting for the L-band and flat launch for the C-band is a good strategy as predicted by the GGN-model.

articleTitle: 64-GBd PDM-256QAM and 92-GBd PDM-64QAM Signal Generation using Precise-Digital-Calibration aided by Optical-Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to precisely distribute equalization for transceiver imperfection between digital and optical domain. 1.7- and 4.6-dB OSNR tolerance improvements were confirmed for PDM-256QAM and PDM-64QAM signals with net-rates of 793 and 851 Gbps/carrier.

articleTitle: Characterization of Long Multi-Mode Fiber Links using Digital Holography
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to use digital holography to characterize long multi-mode fiber links. A four segment 26.5km fiber span supporting 45 spatial modes is analyzed, showing the evolution of both mode-dependent loss and cross talk.

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of G.654.E Fibers for Terrestrial Long Haul Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review G.654.E fibers with low loss and large A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> for terrestrial long haul transmissions in particular emphasis on addressing practical issues on terrestrial cabling, low splice loss, and applicability of Raman amplification.

articleTitle: 92 and 50 Gbps TDM-PON using Neural Network Enabled Receiver Equalization Specialized for PON
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Investigation of NN-based equalizers for 50 & 92-Gbps IM/DD NRZ/PAM-4 TDM-PON. NN is universally trained for OLT-receiver for different fiber reaches and ONU wavelength-variations. Care was taken to avoid overestimation of performance due to overfitting.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Traffic Prediction for Optical Switching Resource Allocation in Hybrid Intra-Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work presents a highly accurate traffic prediction model based on nonlinear autoregressive neural networks for efficient forecasting of heavy traffic streams in intra-data center networks. Its deep-learning version guarantees a prediction error of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup>.

articleTitle: Simple Broadband Bismuth Doped Fiber Amplifier (BDFA) to Extend O-Band Transmission Reach and Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a simple silica-based BDFA with 80nm 6-dB gain-bandwidth flexibly centred within 1305–1325nm, and parameters comparable to EDFAs. The amplifier can extend 400GBASE-LR8 transmission (8×26.6 Gbaud/s PAM-4 channels) beyond 50 km of G.652 fiber.

articleTitle: Accurate Fault Location based on Deep Neural Evolution Network in Optical Networks for 5G and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents an accurate fault location method based on deep neural evolution network in optical networks. Experiments indicate that the proposed method improves the accuracy of fault location when confronted with large-scale alarm sets.

articleTitle: A 4-Channel Beamformer for 9-Gb/s MMW 5G Fixed-Wireless Access Over 25-km SMF with Bit-Loading OFDM
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An MMW 5G-FWA system is experimentally demonstrated with bit-loading OFDM and a 4-channel beamforming receiver. 9 Gb/s data rate is achieved after 25-km transmission with similar BER performance of 0° and 60° incident angles.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of End-to-End Key on Demand Service Provisioning Over Quantum Key Distribution Networks with Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate end-to-end key on demand (KoD) service provisioning over quantum key distribution networks with software defined networking (SDN), achieving efficient and flexible on-demand secret-key rate allocation for end-to-end data security.

articleTitle: A Rapid LiDAR without Mutual Interferences
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a LiDAR without mutual interference for the autonomous vehicles. By using a true random light and a fast correlation measurement method, it is possible to realize a fast LiDAR without mutual interferences.

articleTitle: Highly Nonlinear Fiber for Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review highly nonlinear fibers and techniques for practical parametric amplifiers. Characteristics of fibers for wideband amplification over C-band, quasi-phase-matching technique for flat and 20dB gain, and polarization insensitive configuration avoiding SBS are discussed.

articleTitle: WDM Amplification of One Pump HNLF Based Phase Sensitive Amplifier with Static Pump Phase Tuning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate WDM capable Raman-assisted low-noise phase-sensitive amplifier with up-to ∼26dB gain for 35 channels at 40GHz spacing using FBG phase tuning of single pump. 16QAM constellation shows gain linearity for multi levels formats.

articleTitle: Single-Wavelength and Single-Photodiode Entropy-Loaded 554-Gb/s Transmission Over 22-km SMF
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of intensity-modulated and direct-detected (IM-DD) entropy-loaded signals over 22-km SMF with 554-Gb/s line rate and 460.9-Gb/s net bit rate.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity, Low-PAPR Polarization-Time Code for PDL Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We apply a polarization-time (PT) code based on number theory for PDL mitigation. The PT code has comparable PDL mitigation performance to the best PT codes reported so far, and higher tolerance to fiber nonlinearities.

articleTitle: OTA Enabled 147.4 Gb/s eCPRI-Equivalent-Rate Radio-Over-Fiber Link Cooperating with mmWave-Based Korea Telecom 5G Mobile Network for Distributed Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an over-the-air (OTA) based 4×4 MIMO distributed antenna system with a radio-over-fiber that provides 147.4-Gb/s eCPRI-equivalent-rate, achieving ~4 Gb/s data throughput per cell in conjunction with Korea Telecom 5G mobile network employing mmWave.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Self-Coherent Transceivers for Metro, Access and Inter-Datacenter Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low-complexity transceivers offering high spectral efficiency and dispersion tolerance will be required for short-haul links operating at 100 Gb/s per wavelength and beyond. Recent developments in self-coherent transceivers are described and future research directions suggested.

articleTitle: 200 Gbit/s (68.25 Gbaud) PAM8 Signal Transmission and Reception for Intra-Data Center Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, single carrier, single polarization 200 Gbit/s signal transmission for intra-DCI is demonstrated. Enabling by pre-equalization, adaptive-notch-filter and look-up-table, the BER of 68.25 Gbaud PAM8 signal is below 2.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> after 1-km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: 5G NR Multi-Beam Steering Employing a Photonic TTD Chip Assisted by Multi-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Beam steering demonstration employing integrated optical ring resonators (ORRs) and multi-core fiber with multiple beams at 17.6 GHz and 26 GHz obtains 103.5° beam separation. A 5G system with 4×1 beamforming at 26 GHz provides up to 16.8 Gbps with 20° beam steering.

articleTitle: Clipping-Enhanced Kramers-Kronig Receivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Simulations show that strongly clipping signals to the Kramers-Kronig processing's logarithm (limiting their lower extent) substantially improves error rates, enabling <; 7-dB carrier-to-signal ratios at achievable SNRs, to support low-latency KP4 FEC.

articleTitle: A Single-Mode Expanded Beam Separable Fiber Optic Interconnect for Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An expanded beam optical interconnect is introduced that provides a separable connection between photonic integrated circuit and single-mode fiber. Insertion loss data are provided and stability through solder reflow is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of an Underwater Wireless Optical Link Employing Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Modes with Fast Auto-Alignment System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an underwater optical wireless link employing orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes with fast auto-alignment system to overcome signal fluctuations. The results show that the fast auto-alignment system succeeds to provide stable outputs for superior underwater OAM multiplexing communications.

articleTitle: 3D Shape Sensing Utilizing SBS in Multi-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 3D shape sensing utilizing stimulated Brillouin scattering in multi-core fiber is experimentally demonstrated. A 1.7-m helical curve can be reconstructed with a RMSE of 0.0200 m when the spatial resolution is 20 cm.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Aided In-Phase/Quadrature Skew and Imbalance Calibration for Coherent Optical Transmitters
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We apply artificial neural network to guide the calibration of IQ time skew and amplitude imbalances for coherent optical transmitters with heterodyne detection and modified real-value CMA. 12.8 dB performance improvement is observed after only three calibration steps.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 100 Gbps Per Lambda PAM4 Transmission with 1310 nm and 1330 nm Directly Modulated Lasers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 100Gbps per lambda PAM4 transmission with 1310 nm and 1330 nm directly modulated lasers is demonstrated. Dispersion penalty after transmission through 2km SMF is less than 1 dB measured in TDECQ or receiver sensitivity change.

articleTitle: Practical SDM-ROADM Designs for Uncoupled Spatial Channels and Their Switching Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present SDM-ROADM architectures for independent spatial channel routing and add/drop, investigating C/D/C and degrees of practical directional constraints. These are quantified via the switching capacity metric.

articleTitle: Express Data Center Interconnection using a Photonic Cross Connect
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present measurements of express optical interconnection between data centers using a MEMs photonic cross connect and a packet-optical transport network under the control of a programmable netOS for dynamic traffic steering and resiliency.

articleTitle: High Capacity VCSEL Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent advances and remaining challenges for high capacity VCSEL based links are reviewed. A path to 800Gbps and greater single fiber links is described.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Raman Amplifier Design
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A multi-layer neural network is employed to learn the mapping between Raman gain profile and pump powers and wavelengths. The learned model predicts with high-accuracy, low-latency and low-complexity the pumping setup for any gain profile.

articleTitle: Colorless Coherent Passive Optical Network using a Frequency Comb Local Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a colorless coherent PON architecture alleviating the need for wavelength locking of the ONU lasers. Using two different types of comb sources, we demonstrate error-free reception at -25 dBm received power over bandwidths of 600 GHz and 1 THz, respectively.

articleTitle: Polarization-Diversity 32 × 32 Si Photonics Switch with Non-Duplicate Diversity Circuit in Double-Layer Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-diversity 32×32 Si-photonics switch by newly introducing a SiN overpass circuit onto our non-duplicate polarization-diversity path-independent insertion-loss switch circuit. An average PDL in a sampled connection setting was evaluated as 3.2 dB.

articleTitle: High Spatial Density 6-Mode 7-Core Multicore L-Band Fiber Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present high spatial density SDM amplifier (i.e. 6-mode, 7-core multicore fiber amplifier) supporting 42 spatial channels. More than 17 dB average gain is obtained in the L-band with less than 5.4 dB differential modal gain.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Mitigation Enabling Next Generation High Speed Optical Transport Beyond 100G
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider methods for containment of the effects of optical nonlinearities in coherent optical transmission. These are distinguished according to their practicality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: 120-GBaud 32QAM Signal Generation using Ultra-Broadband Electrical Bandwidth Doubler
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an electrical spectrum synthesis technique using digital pre-processing with an interband crosstalk compensation and newly developed ultra-broadband electrical bandwidth doublers. A 120-GBaud PDM-32QAM signal (net rate: 954.2 Gb/s) has been successfully generated.

articleTitle: Fiber Nonlinear Noise-to-Signal Ratio Estimation by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A machine learning-based estimation method for fiber nonlinear noise-to-signal ratio is proposed, which does not require channel state information. The generalization problem of machine learning model from homogeneous to inhomogeneous cases is als o investigated.

articleTitle: Towards Early Detection of Red Palm Weevil using Optical Fiber Distributed Acoustic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Red palm weevil (RPW) is a severe danger to the dates farming. We use optical fiber distributed acoustic sensor (DAS) as a solution to the detection of RPW via sensing the RPW activities sound.

articleTitle: Polar-Coded Modulation for Joint Channel Coding and Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose joint channel coding and constellation shaping based on polar-coded modulation. Proposed shaping method offers more than 0.6 dB gain without the need of external distribution matcher and the increase of decoding complexity.

articleTitle: OPTUNS: Optical Edge Datacenter Network Architecture and Prototype Testbed for Supporting 5G
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the architecture/testbed of an SDN-based optical-tunnel-network system (OPTUNS) for 5G edge-datacenters. Benchmarking results show that, compared to electrical-spine-leaf datacenter-network, OPTUNS achieves 82.6% power saving and significantly lower mean/p99 latency under high traffic load/locality.

articleTitle: Beyond 200 Gbps Per Lane Intensity Modulation Direct Detection (IM/DD) Transmissions for Optical Interconnects: Challenges and Recent Developments
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: All parts of an IM/DD system are being stretched to the limit as the single lane data rate approaches 200 Gbps and beyond. We report the recent developments on the key enablers conquering this target.

articleTitle: OpenConfig Control of 100G/400G Filterless Metro Networks with configurable Modulation Format and FEC
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: OpenConfig YANG extensions are proposed to enable dynamic selection of transmission parameters of 100G/400G transmitters with coherent reception in a filterless metro network. Data and control plane experimental validations exploiting the ONOS controller are provided.

articleTitle: Novel Time Synchronization Scheme in Delay-Division-Multiplexing OFDM-PON using Sub-Nyquist Sampling
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel time synchronization scheme in a DDM-OFDM-PON under the constraint of sub-Nyquist sampling. In a 25-Gb/s DDM-PON, the scheme can acquire precise delays, making the delay-related penalty in SNR < 0.2 dB.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarization On-Line 256 and 512 QAM Digital Coherent Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first dual-polarization on-line 5 Gbaud, 256 and 512 QAM coherent transmissions using an FPGA-based transmitter and receiver. Error-free operation with 14 % overhead FEC was achieved for 256 QAM-160 km and 512 QAM-20 km transmissions.

articleTitle: Out-of-Field Generic ML Training with In-Field Specific Adaptation to Facilitate ML Deployments
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A two-phase strategy to facilitate ML algorithm deployment in real networks is demonstrated: out-of-field training uses data from simulation and testbed experiments with generic equipment whereas in-field adaptation is applied to support heterogeneous equipment.

articleTitle: Brillouin Optical Time Domain Analysis Incorporating with Backward Rayleigh Light Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An approach of backscattering Rayleigh light detection has been prosed to compensate the nonlocal effect in BOTDA. A hotspot has been measured accurately at the end of the 39-km sensing fiber. Brillouin frequency shift error of 13MHz induced by 2dBm probe power has been corrected.

articleTitle: Weakly-Coupled 6-LP-Mode Fiber with Low Differential Mode Attenuation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evidence the impact of small angle light scattering on Differential Mode Attenuation (DMA) in few-mode fibers. Based on this finding, we design and fabricate a weakly-coupled 6-LP-mode fiber with low DMA.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach to Optical Switching in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical switching can address the energy and bandwidth scaling challenges facing data center networks, but its adoption is impeded by the cost and complexity of associated hardware and control mechanisms. This paper discusses an approach that reduces cost and complexity by co-designing the hardware and overall network architecture.

articleTitle: Standardized Northbound Interface Testing Automation on the Open and Disaggregated Optical Transport Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The proposed demonstration will showcase a live testing of the northbound API on optical DCI equipment which is compliant with the NETCONF network configuration protocol and OpenConfig YANG data models.

articleTitle: Elastic Optical Transmission of 50 Gb/s/Lambda OFDM Based Mobile Fronthaul via DSP-Aided Sub-band Spreading
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Even suffering from two 20-dB attenuated RF fading notches, a 50-Gpbs sub-band spreading OFDM enhanced intensity-modulation mobile fronthaul is experimentally demonstrated over 25-km fiber transmission with a superior EVM performance over the widely-adapted OFDM signals.

articleTitle: Indium Phosphide Membrane Photonics on Silicon
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)

authors.preferredName: J. J. G. M. van der Tol

abstract: Energy-efficiency, bandwidth density and speed requirements drive miniaturisation in photonics and the intimate integration with silicon technologies. IMOS - the integration of InP membranes on silicon - is an active, scalable nanophotonic platform to achieve this.

articleTitle: Optical Field Recovery via Stokes Vector Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first review the architectures and information capacities of Stokes vector direct detection. We then discuss various polarization modulation schemes to recover the optical field and their associated optical and spectral efficiencies.

articleTitle: Optical Fibers for Short-Reach High-Density Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Data centers are striving to meet the challenge of delivering more bandwidth density. In this paper, we discuss reduced diameter fiber designs that enable smaller cables and higher density interconnects for on-board and co-packaged optics.

articleTitle: A 4-Lane 400 Gb/s Silicon Photonic Transceiver for Intra-Datacenter Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a four-lane silicon photonic transceiver for intra-datacenter optical interconnects. A net rate of 400 Gb/s is achieved at a bit error rate below the KP-4 forward error correction threshold of 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>.

articleTitle: Service Provisioning Framework with Dynamic Margin Management for Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes a service provisioning framework exploiting awareness of current optical performance and OTN-switching to efficiently operate transport networks with reduced margins. Simulation results highlight reductions in number of line interfaces and rerouting events.

articleTitle: 4×288Gb/s Orthogonal Offset Carriers Assisted PDM Twin-SSB WDM Transmission with Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 4×288Gb/s direct detection transmission of WDM PDM Twin-SSB signals with orthogonal offset carriers. With Kramers-Kronig detection or joint signal-signal beat interference cancellation, the BERs of all the channels are below 20% HD-FEC Threshold.

articleTitle: Electrically Programmable Equivalent-Phase-Shifted Wave-Guide Bragg Grating for Multichannel Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A silicon-based on-chip electrically programmable equivalent-phase-shifted waveguide Bragg grating implemented through nonuniform spatial sampling to introduce an equivalent phase shift is designed, fabricated and characterized, and its application in multichannel signal processing is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: 850 nm Single-Mode VCSEL for Error-Free 60 Gbit/s OOK Operation and Transmission through 800 m of Multi-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report 60 Gbit/s OOK data transmission with directly modulated 850 nm single-mode VCSELs without applying equalization or digital signal processing. Data transmission over 800 m of multi-mode fiber is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Signal-to-Noise Ratio Prediction using Neural Networks for Multicast Light-Trees in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An adaptive method based on neural networks is proposed, which can simultaneously predict the signal-to-noise ratio at all destination nodes of one multicast light-tree. Results show the method is fast and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Ultra-Fast Zn-Diffusion/Oxide-Relief 940 nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 940nm VCSELs with record-high 3-dB E-O bandwidths as 40 (32) GHz under room-temperature (85°C) operation. It achieves error-free 60Gbps (room-temperature) and 50Gbps (85°C) OOK transmission over 1m and 100m OM5 fiber, respectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive Traffic Data Augmentation using Generative Adversarial Networks for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an adaptive traffic data augmentation technique based on generative adversarial networks trained with partial experimental data for optical networks and verify that the augmented traffic is similar to experimental traffic under diverse scenarios.

articleTitle: Inter-Core Crosstalk Impact of Classical Channels on CV-QKD in Multicore Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Crosstalk-induced excess noise is experimentally characterized for continuous-variable quantum key distribution, spatially multiplexed with WDM PM-16QAM channels in a 19-core fiber. The measured noise-sources are used to estimate the secret key rates for different wavelength channels.

articleTitle: Nyquist Filtering and Fiber Nonlinearity Distortions Mitigation of Three-Carrier 480Gb/s DP-16QAM with Multiplier-Free MAP Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A modified multiplier-free MAP detection is proposed for a three-carrier 480Gb/s Nyquist DP-16QAM system. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate its competitive performance on filtering and fiber nonlinearity distortion mitigation with significantly reduced complexity.

articleTitle: Efficient Thermal Cross-Talk Effect Cancelation in Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel technique, named Thermal Eigemnode Decomposition, able to cancel the effects of thermal cross-talk in arbitrary photonic circuits with heaters is presented. The mapping of thermal cross-talk is obtained only with electrical measurements.

articleTitle: Polarity-Header Optical OFDM for IM/DD Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Polarity-header optical OFDM modulation for bandlimited noncoherent optical communication systems improves the spectral efficiency, providing a better bit error rate performance and higher achievable data rate compared with benchmark schemes.

articleTitle: Slotted Optical Datacenter Networks with Sub-Wavelength Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the dynamic resource allocation problem in a slotted Datacenter network and present fast scheduling solutions to solve it. We then review scalability related issues.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Packet and Optical Layers of a Core Network using SDN Controller, CD ROADMs and Machine-Learning-Based Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show significant cost savings and improved robustness by combining machine learning with joint global optimization of IP and optical layers in a core network through the use of SDN, CD ROADMs and DFCC devices.

articleTitle: Flexible Resource Allocation using Photonic Switched Interconnects for Disaggregated System Architectures
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an optically connected disaggregated system architecture that supports dynamic resource allocation, leveraging the optical spatial switching capability of silicon photonic microring-based interconnects and demonstrate compute nodes on-request access to remote memory and PCIe-based resources.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Integrated Quantum Photonic Technologies for Communications and Computation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Quantum photonics has emerged as a promising approach to realizing large-scale and complex quantum technologies. Here we overview recent developments presenting circuits compriging hundreds of photonic components integrated into single coherent quantum systems.

articleTitle: An All-Silicon Transmitter with Co-Designed Modulator and DC-Coupled Driver
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a co-designed silicon traveling wave modulator with a SiGe driver with 6Vpp effective swing. 34GBaud DP-16QAM is demonstrated with comparable ROSNR performance to a commercial CFP2-ACO.

articleTitle: Field Demonstration of Real-Time Optical Network Diagnosis using Deep Neural Network and Telemetry
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate network diagnosis using deep neural network in the field fiber. Accurate and rapid optical fiber bend estimation is achieved with the help of streaming telemetry implemented in a whitebox packet transponder.

articleTitle: An Efficient Nonlinear Fourier Transform Algorithm for Detection of Eigenvalues from Continuous Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an efficient, fast and robust Nonlinear Fourier Transform (NFT) algorithm to detect eigenvalues of the discrete spectrum. It outperforms other known NFT algorithms as it detects the eigenvalues from the continuous spectrum, the numerically more robust part of the nonlinear spectrum.

articleTitle: VNF Availability Model for Service Provider Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider designing provider networks with VNFs of lower availability than telecom equipment while maintaining an overall high-availability services infrastructure. An optimization model and corresponding performance results are showcased.

articleTitle: Modal Chromatic Dispersion Compensating Fiber Channels using 100G Multimode Optical Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using 100G multimode transceivers, we measure bit error rate over 300 m of dispersion and non-dispersion compensating multimode fiber channels. For both 100GBASE-SR4 and 100G-SWDM4 transceivers, all lanes showed performance advantages on dispersion compensating fiber.

articleTitle: UTC-PD-Integrated HEMT for Optical-to-Millimeter-Wave Carrier Frequency Down-Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We newly developed an InGaAs-channel high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) integrated with a uni-traveling-carrier photodiode (UTC-PD) structure as a carrier frequency down-converter from optical data signals to wireless data signals, which utilizes the photonic double-mixing functionality. It was demonstrated that the output intensity of the down-converted millimeter-wave signal is significantly enhanced by 34 dB compared with a standard HEMT, owning to the integration of the UTC-PD structure. We also verify the feasibility of the UTC-PD-integrated HEMT for practical use in the future full coherent networks.

articleTitle: 64-GBd DP-Bipolar-8ASK Transmission Over 120 km SSMF Employing a Monolithically Integrated Driver and MZM in 0.25-μm SiGe BiCMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 64-GBd signal generation up to bipolar-8-ASK utilizing a single MZM, monolithically integrated with segmented drivers in SiGe. Using polarization multiplexing, 300-Gb/s net data rate transmission over 120 km SSMF is shown.

articleTitle: Broadband and Continuous Beamformer Based on Switched Delay Lines Cascaded by Optical Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A beamforming chip is realized on indium phosphide (InP) employing cascaded optical ring resonators and switched delay lines for wide bandwidth applications. 6.7 Gbps transmission in the K-band (17-22 GHz) is achieved up to 23.1 ps steering on a 4 GHz-wide OFDM signal.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Continuous Improvement in Open Optical Network Design by QoT Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time an interactive process with QoT prediction learning design server for multi-vendor optical networks using vendor-neutral optical model parameter learning from real BER measurements, enabling continuous improvement in network efficiency.

articleTitle: Single Mode, Low-Loss 5-Tube Nested Hollow-Core Anti-Resonant Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 5-tube nested hollow-core anti-resonant fiber is proposed to simultaneously achieve ultra-low loss (<; 1dB/km), broader transmission window, lower bend loss, and larger higher-order mode suppression than fibers with a different number of cladding tubes.

articleTitle: Rate-Adaptive Probabilistic Shaping Enabled by Punctured Polar Codes with Pre-Set Frozen Bits
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to pre-set the frozen bits of a rate-adaptive punctured polar-coded system to pseudo-random sequences. The many-to-one probabilistic shaping gains are improved to 2 dB («160 km) w.r.t. the standard punctured polar-coded system.

articleTitle: Few-Mode Degenerate Four-Wave Mixing in a Few-Mode Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate few-mode degenerate four wave mixing in a few-mode semiconductor optical amplifier with high efficiency and large bandwidth for the first time.

articleTitle: Low-Speed DSP Assisted Dispersion Compensation-Free IM/DD Optical OFDM Transmission Over 100 km-SMF using Time- and Frequency-Domain Sparse-Subcarrier Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Time- and frequency-domain sparse-subcarrier IM/DD optical OFDM system is proposed for dispersion-tolerant transmission. We show a BER improvement for four-subcarrier × 10 Gb/s/subcarrier OFDM, using duo-binary coding and MLSE over 100-km transmission without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Performance of Lasers with Excess Low-Frequency FM-Noise Profiles in Digital Coherent Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that for the same spectral linewidth, lasers with high FM-noise at low frequency outperform those with white FM-noise in a coherent system. Digital carrier-recovery has to be optimized based on laser FM-noise profile.

articleTitle: Seamless Hybrid-Integrated Interconnect NEtwork (SHINE)
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe an optical communication technology scalable across chip-, board-, and rack-interconnect levels for data centers. The approach claims high energy efficiency, large bandwidth density, and is compatible with standard area-bonding and pick-and-place chip assembly.

articleTitle: 4×96 Gbit/s PAM8 for Short-Reach Applications Employing Low-Cost DML without Pre-Equalization
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 4×96-Gbit/s PAM8 transmission enabled by low-cost DMLs with the narrowest 3-dB bandwidth of 13.5-GHz for the first time. Thanks to the optimized Volterra equalizer, 15-km SSMF distance is achieved without optical amplification and pre-equalization.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Data Transmission Based on the Exact Inverse Periodic Nonlinear Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design a two-dimensional signal constellation based on the exact periodic inverse nonlinear Fourier transform. Feasibility of continuous transmission with periodic signals is experimentally demonstrated over more than 2000 km.

articleTitle: Faster-than-Nyquist DMT QPSK/16-QAM Signal Transmission with Iterative Detection and Sphere Decoder
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 40Gbaud faster-than-Nyquist DMT QPSK/16-QAM signal transmission with bandwidth compression ratio of 0.7 and 0.88, respectively. The performance of iterative detection and sphere decoder for inter-carrier interference mitigation are investigated in both simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: A Tutorial at OFC 2019: Ultra High-Speed Quantum-Well Semiconductor Lasers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Evolution of ultra high-speed quantum-well semiconductor lasers with breakthrough technology for data-center and 5G-wireless are fully reviewed from pioneer research up to 100GbE/400GbE application, including challenge and advanced approaches for 800GbE and beyond.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonic Links: Optimizing SiP Modulator Design and Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate improved microwave photonic link performance by optimizing integrated modulator biases and show that plasma-dispersion modulators may achieve intrinsic linearity on par with lithium niobate modulators with link SFDRs greater than 100 dB-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Reduced Complexity Nonlinearity Compensation via Principal Component Analysis and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel fiber nonlinearity post-equalization algorithm using principal component analysis and neural networks. We achieve ∼0.46 dBQ improvement for 21 Gbaud DP-8QAM transmission over ∼13,000 km deployed fiber with over 90% complexity reduction.

articleTitle: Optimization of Secure Quantum Key Distribution Backbones in Core Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a Mixed Integer Linear Programming formulation to perform optimal placement of Quantum Key Distribution devices to protect active/planned traffic at minimal cost, thus securing active core transport networks.

articleTitle: 56-Gbit/s Operations of Mach-Zehnder Modulators using 300-μm-Long Membrane InGaAsP Phase Shifters and SiN waveguides on Si
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Mach-Zehnder modulators using 300-μm-long membrane phase shifters and SiN waveguides, in which InGaAsP core is buried with InP, are fabricated on Si. Devices exhibit 56-Gbit/s NRZ signal modulations with clear eye-openings.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Inverse Modeling for Integrated Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a deep neural network model that instantaneously predicts the optical response of nanopatterned silicon photonic power splitter topologies, and inversely approximates compact (2.6 × 2.6 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and efficient (above 92%) power splitters for target splitting ratios.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Ge/Si Avalanche Photodetector Arrays for Lidar Application
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report Ge-on-Si APD arrays with up to 10-by-10 pixels at 1550nm. Our demonstration reveals highly uniform responsivity of ~3.3 A/W with <;7% variation. The bandwidth is 9GHz and 0.7GHz for single and 10×10 array.

articleTitle: Multi Scrolls Chaotic Encryption for Physical Layer Security in CO-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel 3-dimension multi scrolls chaotic encryption for physical layer security in CO-OFDM. A key space of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">324</sup> is created to enhance the security level of OFDM data encryption with lower encryption complexity.

articleTitle: High Frequency Current Sensor System using a 4ch CWDM MUX Module and DeMUX ROSA
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a high frequency current sensor for partial discharge detection and the signal processing board equipped with 4ch DeMUX ROSA for 4 channel partial discharge diagnosis. From the experimental results, it was confirmed that the detection data of partial discharge on the 22.9kV XLPE cable can be transmitted well.

articleTitle: Inverse Design and Demonstration of Ultracompact Silicon Polarization Rotator
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact silicon polarization rotator based on inverse-designed subwavelength structures is proposed and experimentally exhibited high performance with high extinction ratio of 19 dB, a footprint of 1.2 × 7.2 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and only one-step etching.

articleTitle: Efficient Low-Loss Adaptive Optical Filters Based on Silicon Oxycarbide — Liquid Crystal Hybrid Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present results from experimental investigations on adaptive optical filters based on a silicon oxycarbide - liquid crystal hybrid technology and show that the transmission characteristics can be adjusted by low voltage digital driving signals.

articleTitle: Flexible Photonic Spectral Shaping at Ultrahigh Resolution of 125MHz
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a proof of concept resolution-enhanced flexible spectral shaper, using a spectral encoding block with high resolution features before the spatial diffractive element. Ultrahigh 125MHz resolution is obtained, refining present limit of 0.8GHz.

articleTitle: Enhanced Nonlinearity Compensation Efficiency of Optical Phase Conjugation System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate enhanced efficiency of nonlinearity compensation, by 13dB, when deploying mid-link optical phase conjugation in discretely-amplified systems. Our demonstration is based on dispersion-loading, using standard transmission fiber, which enhances the reach by 75km.

articleTitle: Optical Network Technologies for 5G Mobile Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper describes optical network technologies to accommodate various types of 5G base stations.

articleTitle: A Directly Modulated Quantum Dot Microring Laser Transmitter with Integrated CMOS Driver
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated heterogeneous quantum-dot laser transmitter directly modulated by a CMOS driver. Utilizing a developed co-simulation laser model enables the design of an asymmetric 2-tap equalizer to achieve a record 12 Gb/s operation.

articleTitle: 5G Rural Strategy in India
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The talk will provide an overview of the Indian telecom scenario, the national digital communications policy, key connectivity programmes, 5G rollout related policy and regulatory overview, the key technologies expected to constitute the 5G networks in India.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Remote Seismic Events in Metropolitan Area Fibers using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and Spatio-Temporal Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Remote seismic activity is monitored with DAS using a pre-existent fiber installation in an urban area. Background noise, which greatly exceeds the amplitude of the monitored seismic signals, is eliminated via 2D (spatio-temporal) signal processing.

articleTitle: All-Silicon IQ Modulator for 100 GBaud 32QAM Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-silicon modulator operating at 100 Gbaud 32QAM. We achieve BER below the 20% FEC-threshold for a line-rate of 500 Gb/s on a single polarization. We describe signal processing and chip operating point optimization.

articleTitle: Transport API Extensions for the Interconnection of Multiple NFV Infrastructure Points of Presence
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the provisioning of constrained connectivity services and protection/restoration scenarios using Transport API for the interconnection of multiple NFV infrastructure points of presence, which is needed for the uptake of NFV at telecom operators.

articleTitle: Coherent Detection Only by 2-D Photodetector Array: A Discreteness-Aware Phase Retrieval Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple and spatially-flexible coherent receiver without local lights, optical hybrids, or spatial de-multiplexers is experimentally demonstrated; 2×10-Gbaud SDM QPSK signals were detected only by 2-D arrayed photodetectors based on a novel phase-retrieving technique.

articleTitle: Polarization Effects on Thermally Stable Latency in Hollow-Core Photonic Bandgap Fibres
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Hollow-Core fibers were recently demonstrated to have propagation time through them completely insensitive to changes in temperature. Here, we consider polarization dependent behaviour of these fibers and show how it can alter the fibre design.

articleTitle: Impact of Nonlinear Impairments in MDM Transmissions using Rescaled Multimode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that the nonlinear impairments in mode-division multiplexing systems scale opposite to the spatial density of modes in multimode fibers with a constant numerical aperture.

articleTitle: An Improved Thermo-Optic Phase Shifter with AlN Block for Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an efficient and fast thermo-optic phase shifter for integrated silicon photonics. By inserting a small AlN block between the TiN heater and Si waveguide, both the phase-shifting efficiency and the modulation speed are improved from ~9.4 to ~8.2 mW/π and from ~26 to ~32 kHz, respectively, as compared to the counterpart without the AlN block. The improvement can be attributed to the very large thermal conductivity of AlN (~285 W/m-K), which makes the waveguide has almost similar temperature as the heater upon it is heated. Numerical simulation shows that the proposed method is also applicable for the Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguide.

articleTitle: Single-Wavelength Symmetric 50 Gbit/s Equalization-Free NRZ IM/DD PON with up to 33 dB Loss Budget and Fiber Transmission over >40 km
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate burst-mode upstream and continuous-mode downstream transmission in a 50G TDM-PON system, achieving up to 33-dB loss budget with a maximum of 77-km SMF transmission before any equalization. The system is enabled by semiconductor optical amplifiers at the transceivers.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Static and Dynamic Crosstalk in Trench-Assisted Multi-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the time-dependent crosstalk characteristics of trench-assisted multi-core fibers in a temperature controlled environment. Results indicate that temperature, PRBS length, modulation format and signaling rate impact the intensity and volatility of inter-core crosstalk.

articleTitle: Impact of Optical Lithography Resolution on Silicon Arrayed Waveguide Grating Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon AWGs fabricated using 193-nm lithography show a substantial performance improvement over those using 248-nm processes in the same foundry. AWG total crosstalk could be suppressed to -30dB through phase error correction in design.

articleTitle: 53-Gbaud PAM4 Differential Drive of a Conventional EA/DFB Toward Driver-Amplifier-Less Optical Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 53-Gbaud-PAM4 differential drive of a conventional EA/DFB was demonstrated. Almost the same waveform as single-ended drive was confirmed with outer ER of 4.1 dB and TDECQ of 1.63 dB by differential drive with 0.57 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>/lane.

articleTitle: Telecom Compatible Quantum Key Distribution — Learning from Classical Coherent Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables secure cryptography that is safe against future attacks by quantum computers. We show recent advances in continuous variable QKD and highlight similarities and differences to classical coherent communication.

articleTitle: Observation and Compensation of Guided Acoustic-Wave Brillouin Scattering in Modulated Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore the SNR penalty introduced by GAWBS over trans-oceanic distances. A digital compensation technique is proposed, and its limitations are investigated. In simulations we demonstrate an uncompensated penalty of 0.4 dB after 7000 km.

articleTitle: Reduction of Nonlinear Distortion in SOA-Based Wavelength Conversion System by Post-Blind-Compensation based on Machine Learning Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinearities in SOA-based wavelength conversion are experimentally tackled using post-blind-compensation based on machine learning clustering for coherent 16/64-QAM signals. We show that K-means outperforms fuzzy-logic since it tackles more effectively non-circularly-symmetric Gaussian noise and nonlinearity.

articleTitle: ARoF-Fed Antenna Architectures for 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 5G mm-wave communications requires a highly densified network of radio access stations to ensure sufficient coverage. Low-complexity nodes based on C-RAN and ARoF fronthaul combined with advanced antenna concepts offer a suitable and potentially low cost technology for single and multi-beam 5G applications.

articleTitle: Scheduling with Flow Prediction Based on Time and Frequency 2D Classification for Hybrid Electrical/Optical Intra-Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper first presents a 2D traffic classification-based flow prediction method and a corresponding resource allocation algorithm supported by B-RNN in intra-datacenter networks. Results show that the proposed method improves prediction accuracy and network performance.

articleTitle: INTREPID: Developing Power Efficient Analog Coherent Interconnects to Transform Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The INTREPID program is developing power efficient coherent optics for package-level integration with future switch ICs as a path to realizing higher-radix switches for flatter networks while enabling new architectures incorporating optical routing and switching.
