abstract: We demonstrate an ultimate flexible approach for simultaneous OFDM and N-OTDM transmission, using intermediate grids between time and frequency axes. We achieve open eye diagrams, and performance below the FEC limit in an 89.2-km field-trial.

articleTitle: Subcarrier Power Loading for Coherent Optical OFDM Optimized by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Enhanced power loading based on machine learned subcarrier interactions and nonlinear SNR progression is proposed to improve BER performance in optical coherent OFDM systems, achieving a gain of 0.5 dB in OSNR vs. classical schemes.

articleTitle: Autonomic NFV Network Services on Top of Disaggregated Optical Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Control and orchestration of metro network to support dynamic provisioning and reconfiguration of services based on Virtual Network Functions are demonstrated through a CDN example. Interaction among CASTOR MDA, OSM and ONOS is exhibited.

articleTitle: High-Performance Hybrid-Integrated Silicon Photonic Tunable Laser
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a silicon photonic tunable laser for coherent communication, with output power reaching 140 mW across the C-band, linewidth narrower than 80 kHz, SMSR larger than 50 dB, and precise gridless frequency tuning.

articleTitle: Electronic Circuits for High Speed PON Beyond 25G
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Tightly integrated and co-optimized electronic and photonic integrated circuits are key to meet the scalability and performance requirements for next-generation optical access. We address the challenges, design considerations and methodology for such circuits at >25G rates.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Optimization of Multi Core Fibre Transmission Links based on Silicon Photonic Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a genetic algorithm based system that can optimize optical interconnects using silicon photonic multi-core fibre coupled transceiver. The GA selects 48 parameters to deliver a minimum 6.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-16</sup> BER on channels with diverse losses.

articleTitle: Mobility-Aware 5G Midhaul Network Design for Optimizing Edge Computing Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 5G midhaul design algorithm for connecting suitable groups of distributed units to each central unit based on the mobility patterns of connected vehicles, with the goal of minimizing edge computing resources.

articleTitle: LCoS-Based Photonic Crossconnect
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 16 × 16 photonic crossconnect using LCoS steering, with an average insertion loss of 4 dB, which allows alignment error to be corrected and demonstrates power splitting for increased network functionality.

articleTitle: Silicon-Chip-Based Brillouin Lasers and Soliton Microcombs using an Integrated Ultra-High-Q Silica Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A monolithic ultra-high-Q silica resonator featuring an integrated silicon-nitride waveguide is described. The resonator can be configured for either high-coherence Brillouin laser action or stable microwave-rate mode locking over C-band at low pumping power.

articleTitle: Possibility to Eliminate Network Operation Center
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Event Based Correlation: Single TT/W.O thru enriched alarm for single fiber cable cut, for different interface down alarms on different network technologies. Topology Based Correlation: Identification of exact restoration path in case of multiple node isolations by grouping of those alarms within the geo fencing network topology.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic MEMS: Exploiting Mechanics at the Nanoscale to Enhance Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With the maturing and the increasing complexity of Silicon Photonics technology, novel avenues are pursued to reduce power consumption and to provide enhanced functionality: exploiting mechanical movement in advanced Silicon Photonic Integrated Circuits provides a promising path to access a strong modulation of the effective index and to low power consumption by employing mechanically stable and thus non-volatile states. In this paper, we will discuss recent achievements in the development of MEMS enabled systems in Silicon Photonics and outline the roadmap towards reconfigurable general Photonic Integrated Circuits.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Fourier Transform for Nonlinear Fibre Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The nonlinear Fourier transform is a transmission and signal processing technique that takes into account inherent nonlinear properties of fibre-optic channels. I will discuss its potential applications in the general context of nonlinear communication theory.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact and Polarization-Insensitive MMI Coupler Based on Inverse Design
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a polarization-insensitive MMI coupler with a footprint of 2.4×2.4 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. It allows for >90% transmission efficiency for both TE and TM polarized optical wave with a wavelength range from 1480 ~ 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Optical PAM4 Signaling and System Performance for DCI Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Three different PAM4-based transmission systems are demonstrated for enhancing the receiver sensitivity, increasing the capacity, and extending the reach over SMF/MMF. The measured BERs are presented as a function of OMA for system performance comparison.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Reduced-Size LUT Predistortion for 256QAM SiP Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a predistortion method combining a linear equalizer and nonlinear reduced-size lookup table (LUT) for a silicon based IQ modulator at 20 Gbaud 256QAM. We achieve BER well below the 20% FEC-threshold.

articleTitle: Distributed Pumping Architecture to Improve the Noise Performance of Broadband Discrete Raman Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a novel dual-stage broadband discrete Raman amplifier which improves low wavelength noise figure by 3.3dB providing 1.2dB Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> factor improvement and 1134km reach extension versus a conventional single-stage design for 18×120Gb/s PM-QPSK transmission.

articleTitle: Optical Arbitrary Waveform Generator Based on Time-Domain Multiplane Light Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present theoretically lossless optical arbitrary waveform generation based on time-domain multi-plane light conversion, with alternating phase modulation and dispersion. We demonstrate the concept by implementing Nyquist shaped QPSK and OOK using phase modulation only.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of mmWave Multi-Beam Forming by SiN Photonic Integrated Circuits for Elastic RF-Optical Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a two-beam 24-GHz mmWave spatial-division multiplexing demonstration using multi-layer SiN photonic integrated circuits for elastic RF-Optical 5G networking. The total system throughput can reach 8-Gbps over 1 GHz bandwidth with 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: IlI-V/Si PICs Based on Micro-Transfer-Printing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: III-V opto-electronic devices (photodiodes, etched facet lasers) are micro-transfer-printed onto silicon waveguide circuits. An alignment-tolerant interface for evanescently-coupled devices is proposed enabling III-V/Si heterogeneously integrated PICs using micro-transfer-printing.

articleTitle: Efficient Optical Modulator by Reverse-Biased III-V/Si Hybrid MOS Capacitor Based on FK Effect and Carrier Depletion
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present efficient optical phase modulation based on Franz-keldysh effect and carrier depletion in reverse-biased III-V/Si hybrid MOS capacitor. The high modulation efficiency and small capacitance enables significant improvement in modulation bandwidth and modulation energy.

articleTitle: High Bit-Rate Quantum Communication Chips
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: There is growing incentive to integrate quantum communication technologies into our high-bandwidth communication networks. However, for a realistic and practical large-scale deployment, drastic reductions of the size, cost and power consumption of current quantum cryptographic systems are necessary. We show how this goal can be achieved using photonic integration. We demonstrate quantum communication chips capable of record performances including quantum key distribution at 250kb/s over a 20dB-loss channel and quantum random number generation at 8Gb/s. The scalability and affordability of these new devices will allow the deployment of quantum cryptography in high connectivity networks.

articleTitle: Large Scale Silicon Photonics Switches Based on MEMS Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the recent developments in large-scale silicon photonic switches, focusing on MEMS-based switches that enables high port-count (128×128), low optical loss (0.05 dB/port), low crosstalk, broadband operation, sub-microsecond response time, and low power consumption.

articleTitle: InP PIC's Scalability for Datacenter Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP PIC fabrication platforms have seen an accelerated development over the recent years. Monolithic integration allows novel concepts in packaging and testing technology. Altogether they enable a ready to scale cost-effective InP PIC ecosystem.

articleTitle: Simplified Bit-Level Shaping with High Spectral Efficiency and High Throughput
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a simplified bit-level shaping method by optimizing the structure of product distribution matcher for high spectral efficiency and high throughput. Simulation and experimental comparisons based on 64QAM demonstrate the efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Mode-Dependent Probabilistic Shaping for Highly-Efficient Weakly Coupled 10-Mode Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We newly introduced mode-dependent probabilistically shaped (PS-) QAM signals for modal XT limited weakly coupled few-mode fiber transmission and the 16% higher aggregated SE over 81-km transmission than that of QPSK signals was obtained.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of a Novel Rack-Scale Disaggregated Data Center with Fast Optical Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate a novel disaggregated architecture based on nanoseconds optical switches. Results show that under data-traffic from real applications the disaggregated architecture with 0.2 local memory rate and 40Gb/s optical links outperforms the server-centric architecture.

articleTitle: A Mode Locked Fiber Laser with Switchable High-Order Modes using Intracavity Acousto-Optic Mode Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a mode-switchable generation of LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11a/b</sub> modes via a dual-resonant acousto-optic mode converter. Within the configuration of mode-locked intracavity laser output, this approach has very potential applications in mode division multiplexing system, particle manipulation.

articleTitle: 850 nm VCSELs for 50 Gb/s NRZ Error-Free Transmission over 100-Meter OM4 and up to 115 °C Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 850-nm multi-mode oxide-VCSELs with record performance of 50-Gb/s (RT) and 44-Gb/s (85°C) NRZ error-free transmission over 100-meter OM4 are demonstrated. The L-I-V, optical bandwidth and BER of 30 GHz VCSEL are characterized up to 115°C.

articleTitle: Multi-Operator Orchestration of Connectivity Services Exploiting Stateful BRPC and BGP-LS in the 5GEx Sandbox
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: QoS-based connectivity coordinated by the 5GEx Multi-domain Orchestrator exploiting novel stateful BRPC is demonstrated for the first time over a multi-operator multi-technology transport network within the European 5GEx Sandbox, including Segment Routing and optical domains.

articleTitle: Modified KK Receiver with Accurate Field Reconstruction at Low CSPR Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A modified KK receiver based on an exponential operation is proposed to accurately reconstruct the field at a low CSPR in a DD system. We experimentally demonstrate a 2-dB sensitivity improvement after 40-km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: Dynamic Crosstalk Study in a Few-Mode-Multi-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate crosstalk fluctuations between cores and modes in a few-mode-MCF, observing almost 20dB power fluctuations for CW signals. We then measure increased crosstalk penalty for LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> modes compared to the more confined LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> modes.

articleTitle: Daylight Operation of a High-Speed Free-Space Quantum Key Distribution using Silica-Based Integration Chip and Micro-Optics-Based Module
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a high-speed quantum key distribution (QKD) system integrated with a compact self-developed silica-based planar lightwave circuit chip and a micro-optics-based polarization module. Also, we demonstrated that our system can generate average secure keys at the rate of 701.22 kbps over a free-space link of 275 m in daylight by using effective noise filtering systems in the temporal, spectral, and spatial domains. Real-time beam tracking system was adopted to stabilize the fluctuation of the beam position.

articleTitle: A SiGe HBT BiCMOS 1-to-4 ADC Frontend Supporting 100 GBaud PAM4 Reception at 14 GHz Digitizer Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An analog 1-to-4 demultiplexer in SiGe HBT BiCMOS technology serving as ADC frontend enables reception of a 100-GBaud PAM4 signal after 40-km SMF transmission with an ADC bandwidth of only 14 GHz.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Multi-Tenant Secret-Key Assignment for Quantum Key Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning based online multi-tenant secret-key assignment algorithm for quantum key distribution networks, capable of reducing tenant-request blocking probability more than half compared to the benchmark heuristics.

articleTitle: Converging Underwater and FSO Ground Communication Links
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new combined underwater-atmospheric optical communication link for providing a high speed optical connectivity between onshore and sumerge systems. New average BER expressions are derived when assuming amplify-and-forward (AF) relay.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Ultra-Wideband WDM Transmission Based on Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the use of semiconductor optical amplifiers to enlarge optical bandwidth of next generation WDM systems. We review recent results, including lab demonstration and field trial, based on novel 100+nm-wide SOA device.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Quantum-Secured, Inter-Domain 5G Service Orchestration and On-Demand NFV Chaining Over Flexi-WDM Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: First demonstration of quantum-secured end-to-end VNS composition through dynamic chaining of VNFs from multiple-domains. We rely on a novel quantum-switched flexi-grid WDM network and q-ROADM for inter-connectivity and on-demand selection of transport functions for quality-of-service.

articleTitle: Dual-Microring Resonator Based 8×8 Silicon Photonic Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: First demonstration of a dual-microring 8×8 silicon-photonic switch in a compact 4 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint shows 4.4-8.4 dB end-to-end on-chip loss, -16.75 dB first-order switching crosstalk, and 40 GHz switching bandwidth capable of high-data-rate datacenter transmissions.

articleTitle: Wavelength-Shifted Protection for WDM-PON with AMCC Scheme for 5G Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose wavelength-shifted protection using an auxiliary management and control channel (AMCC) scheme against feeder fiber faults for WDM-PON without additional active devices. Its validity is demonstrated on an AMCC evaluation platform for 50-ms operation.

articleTitle: 35-Tb/s C-Band Transmission Over 800 km Employing 1-Tb/s PS-64QAM Signals Enhanced by Complex 8 × 2 MIMO Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the full C-band 1-Tb/s/λ WDM 800-km transmission with 35-Tb/s capacity employing novel complex 8 × 2 MIMO equalizer which enables simultaneous compensation of imperfections of transmitter and receiver of 120-Gbaud probabilistically-shaped-64QAM signals.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Functional Devices for Mode-Division (De)Multiplexing in Conventional Graded-Index Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and fabricate all-fiber orbital angular momentum (OAM) functional devices for mode-division (de)multiplexing in conventional graded-index multimode fiber, based on which OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±01</sub>, OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±11</sub> and OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">±21</sub> (de)multiplexing in OM3 fiber is successfully demonstrated in the experiment with favorable mode-crosstalk performance.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Container-Based Microservices SDN Control platform for Open Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a microservices SDN control platform that provides network control plane as a service with the capabilities to instantiate, upgrade, automated and on-demand deployment of the control components such as the controller and its applications.

articleTitle: 84 GBd Faster-Than-Nyquist PAM-4 Transmission using Only Linear Equalizer at Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on Tomlinson-Harashima precoding, we demonstrate 84 GBd PAM-4 transmission in an intensity-modulation direct-detection system with 33 GHz brick-wall bandwidth limitation. BER below 7% hard-decision FEC threshold is achieved using only linear equalizer at receiver.

articleTitle: 240×240 Wafer-Scale Silicon Photonic Switches
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on 240×240 silicon photonic MEMS switches on 4cm × 4cm dies realized by wafer-scale integration and reticle stitching. The maximum on-chip loss is measured to be 9.8dB and the crosstalk is below -70dB.

articleTitle: Ultra-High Resolution Distributed Strain Sensing Based on Phase-OTDR
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-high resolution distributed strain sensor assisted with Rayleigh-scattering enhanced optical fiber and phase noise compensation scheme, realizing a static strain resolution of 1.89 re and dynamic resolution of 97. 5 pe/V Hz over 1Hz.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Efficient Recovery for Secure Distributed Control in Software Defined Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents a blockchain-based high-efficiency security strategy with blockchain ledger-based recovery algorithm for software-defined optical networks. Numerical results show the proposed strategy has less recovery latency and superior network performances.

articleTitle: 104 Gbaud OOK and PAM-4 Transmission Over 1km of SMF using a Silicon Photonics Transmitter with Quarter-Rate Electronics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a silicon photonics transmitter using four GeSi EAMs driven at 26 Gbaud with 1.2Vpp to realize the fastest reported single-wavelength PAM-4 transmission on silicon at 208 Gb/s over 1km of SMF.

articleTitle: Real-Time Interrogation of Multiplexed FBG Strain Sensors Based on a Thermally Tunable Microring Resonator Array
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-resolution integrated multi-wavelength FBG interrogator is proposed based on a microring resonator array. Two-channel strain sensing is demonstrated with the dynamic stain resolution of 30 nε/√Hz over 100 Hz to 1 kHz.

articleTitle: Multi-Core Fiber Socket-Assisted Packaging for 84-Channel Ultra-Dense Silicon Photonics IO
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A femtosecond-laser 3D structured silica chip with alignment sockets has permitted precise and compact packaging of multi-core fiber for edge coupling to silicon photonic chips, with average single-pass loss of ~5.6 dB over 84 channels.

articleTitle: A 112 Gb/s PAM4 Transmitter with Silicon Photonics Microring Modulator and CMOS Driver
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 112 Gb/s PAM4 transmitter using silicon photonics microring modulator, on-chip laser and co-packaged CMOS driver. Measured TDECQ is <;0.7 dB from 30°C to 60°C with on-chip nonlinear feed-forward equalization enabled.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Bandwidth-Allocation Scheme for Network-Slicing-Based TDM-PON toward 5G and IoT Era
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a bandwidth allocation scheme for converging 5G mobile fronthaul and IoT networks on a TDM-PON. Experiments show that the scheme can simultaneously provide low-latency transmission, bandwidth guarantee, and auto-discovery process.

articleTitle: Equalization and Interoperability Challenges in Next Generation Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To reach higher line rates in interoperability conditions, we experiment the possibility to have a unified set of channel equalization coefficients for different transmitted wavelengths, received optical power, and optical receivers.

articleTitle: Impact of Modulation Format on Dynamic Channel Crosstalk Behavior in Multi-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a study on the relation between the spectral occupation of crosstalk-generating signals and the resulting dynamic crosstalk behavior. We show performance fluctuations induced by varying crosstalk power when transmitting carrier supported modulation formats.

articleTitle: Photonics-Aided Mm-Wave Communication for 5G
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To meet the eMBB challenges in 5G, we have systematically explored the potential of the photonics-aided mm-wave communication in terms of the wireless transmission capacity and distance it can accommodate. Enabled by various kinds of advanced techniques and devices, we have successfully achieved the significant enhancement of the wireless transmission capacity from 100Gb/s to 400Gb/s, even to 1Tb/s, and we also have realized the record-breaking product of wireless transmission capacity and distance, i.e., 54Gb/s×2.5km.

articleTitle: HPC Interconnects at the End of Moore's Law
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The tapering of lithography advances that have been associated with Moore's Law will substantially change requirements for future interconnect architectures for large-scale datacenters and HPC systems. Architectural specialization is creating new datacenter requirements such as emerging accelerator technologies for machine learning workloads and rack disaggregation strategies will push the limits of current interconnect technologies. Whereas photonic technologies are often sold on the basis of higher bandwidth and energy efficiency (e.g. lower picojoules per bit), these emerging workloads and technology trends will shift the emphasis to other metrics such as bandwidth density (as opposed to bandwidth alone) and reduced latency, and performance consistency. Such metrics cannot be accomplished with device improvements alone, but require a systems view of photonics in datacenters.

articleTitle: 132-Gb/s Photonics-Aided Single-Carrier Wireless Terahertz-Wave Signal Transmission at 450GHz Enabled by 64QAM Modulation and Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 132-Gb/s (12-Gbaud) photonics-aided single-carrier PDM-64QAM-PS5.5 THz-wave signal transmission at 450GHz over 20-km fiber-optics and 1.8-m wireless distance with BER under 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. The employment of probabilistic-constellation-shaping significantly improves transmission capacity and system performance.

articleTitle: Biological Attractor Selection and SDN Control Interworking in the Virtual Packet Optical Node Network Control
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Biological Attractor Selection (BAS) is a promised network control technology to ensure environmental fluctuation. This demonstration shows BAS and software defined networking control interworking for controlling the virtual packet optical node network.

articleTitle: Impact of the Number of Channels on the Induced Nonlinear Distortions in Ultra-Wideband SOAs
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the impact of wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) channel count onto the nonlinear distortions induced by an ultra-wideband (UWB) semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We demonstrate experimentally that UWB SOA devices are well suited for wideband WDM signal amplification.

articleTitle: 107 Tb/s Transmission of 103-nm Bandwidth over 3×100 km SSMF using Ultra-Wideband Hybrid Raman/SOA Repeaters
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the ultra-wideband transmission of 254 PCS-64QAM channels over 300 km of SSMF. We demonstrate a 107-Tb/s transmission throughput over a continuous 103 nm optical bandwidth using backward Raman pumping and SOA technology.

articleTitle: Mode-Division Multiplexing Systems for High-Capacity Optical Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews the recent technical challenges on mode-division multiplexing (MDM) transport systems for high-capacity Optical Transport Network. Desired features and issues of the MDM system are discussed for long-haul transmission performance over 1,000 km.

articleTitle: Real-Time 16QAM Transatlantic Record Spectral Efficiency of 6.21 b/s/Hz Enabling 26.2 Tbps Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Real-time, error-free 16QAM transmission at a record spectral efficiency of 6.21 b/s/Hz enables transatlantic (6,644 km) fiber capacity of 26.2 Tbps, using precision, multi-carrier common wavelocking; digitally synthesized subcarriers; near-Nyquist pulse shaping; and large-area, positive dispersion fiber.

articleTitle: Net Data Rate of 14.6 Gbit/s Underwater VLC Utilizing Silicon Substrate Common-Anode Five Primary Colors LED
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a net data rate of 14.6 Gbit/s DFT-S OFDM over 1.2m of UVLC. A self-designed Silicon substrate five primary colors LED is employed to improve system performance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that 14Gb/s signal transmission is experimentally achieved with LED in the underwater optical wireless communication.

articleTitle: Silicon Polarization Splitter and Rotator with Tolerance to Width Variations using a Nonlinearly-Tapered and Partially-Etched Directional Coupler
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A silicon polarization splitter and rotator is experimentally demonstrated using a nonlinearly-tapered directional coupler. Adiabatic polarization splitting and rotating are achieved over a length of 129 μm. Fabrication tolerance to waveguide widths is also verified.

articleTitle: Blind Polarization Demultiplexing and Equalization of Probabilistically Shaped QAM
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel, two-stage algorithm for polarization demultiplexing and equalization of probabilistically shaped QAM is presented. It operates blindly, requiring no knowledge of the channel or transmitted sequence. Performance is validated under realistic PMD conditions.

articleTitle: Gap Analysis on Open Models for Partially-Disaggregated SDN Optical Transport Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an analysis of completeness and suitability of OpenConfig, OpenROADM and OpenDevice models, for physical-impairment aware network planning, and a proof-of-concept in a partially disaggregated testbed exposing equipment information to Net2Plan through ONOS.

articleTitle: Accuracy Enhancement of Indoor Visible Light Positioning using Point-Wise Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A point-wise reinforcement learning (PWRL) algorithm is proposed for a multi-detector based visible light positioning system. Experimental results demonstrate that the average positioning error is reduced up to 70% by employing the proposed PWRL.

articleTitle: Hybrid Polarization Pulling and Pushing Effects for Eliminating Brillouin Gain Fluctuation in Golay-Coded BOTDA Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A scheme based on hybrid polarization pulling and pushing effects is utilized for eliminating Brillouin gain fluctuation in Golay-coded BOTDA sensor. Maximum Brillouin gain fluctuation is reduced from ~ 0.31% to ~ 0.04%.

articleTitle: Long-Term Stable Electro-Optic Polymer for Hybrid Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The high-temperature-resistant electro-optic polymer is used to demonstrate 100 Gbit/s OOK and 112 Gbit/s PAM4 modulations. The polymer is performed on the silicon Mach-Zehnder interferometer toward possible hybrid silicon and polymer photonic platform.

articleTitle: Open Design for Multi-Vendor Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review physical layer models to design and simulate open line systems, enabling vendor interoperability. An open algorithm that takes into account different engineering choices is presented and used to optimize power on a WDM link.

articleTitle: Maximizing Optical Network Capacity through SNR-Availability Based Provisioning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a new SNR-availability based provisioning scheme to maximize capacity while satisfying target service availability in optical networks employing fine tunable modulations such as probabilistically shaped mQAM, and show up to 36% capacity gain.

articleTitle: Visible Light Communications: From Theory to Industrial Standardization
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Visible light communication (VLC) builds upon the ubiquitous presence of LEDs and exploits the existing illumination infrastructure for wireless access. VLC provides high data rate transmission in unregulated optical spectrum and is considered as a powerful complement to radio frequency based solutions in user dense environments or as an alternative in places where radio waves may not be permitted or restricted. In this paper, we first provide an overview of this promising technology and highlight its unique advantages and applications areas. Then, we discuss the commercialization potential and present ongoing international standardization activities which are seen by the industry as a key requirement to address the mass market adoption.

articleTitle: Noise Mitigation of Random Data Signals Through Linear Temporal Sampling Based on the Talbot Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Noiseless passive amplification of non-repetitive waveforms, e.g., non-return-to-zero data signals, is achieved up to a factor of 28.5 through a linear Talbot-based lossless temporal sampling process, enabling recovery of signals entirely buried under noise.

articleTitle: Achievable Rate Comparison Between Entropy and Bit Loading in a 100-Gb/s DM-DD DMT System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an efficient entropy loading (EL) scheme with NGMI target based on lookup tables. We reveal the EL superiority on channel coding over bit loading in a 100-Gb/s DMT system, proving EL as the optimum capacity-approaching modulation for band-limited transceivers.

articleTitle: 92-Gbaud PAM4 Transmission using Spectral-Shaping Trellis-Coded-Modulation with 20-GHz Bandwidth Limitation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a simple nonlinear trellis-coded-modulation to realize spectral-shaping for short-reach IM-DD transmission. Simulation results show the improvement of bandwidth-limitation and chromatic-dispersion tolerances. Experimental results show the achievement of 7% HD-FEC threshold in 184-Gb/s transmission.

articleTitle: COSMOS: Optical Architecture and Prototyping
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The COSMOS testbed provides an open-access and programmable multi-layer beyond 5G wireless platform built on an advanced optical x-haul network supporting mobile edge cloud base band processing and applications.

articleTitle: Field Trial of 1.5-Gbps 97-GHz Train Communication System Based on Linear Cell Radio Over Fiber Network for 240-km/h High-Speed Train
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 97-GHz millimeter-wave radio access system connected to bidirectional radio over fiber network for high-speed train systems. Obtained throughput from a central office to a 240-km/h train car is achieved 1.5 Gbps.

articleTitle: Impact of Carrier-Phase Estimation on Noise Transductions for Optical Performance Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of CPE the estimation linear and nonlinear noises is studied. Using previously reported second-order statistical metrics, CPE increases the maximum error from 0.16dB to 0.59dB whereas alternative metrics give 0.26dB independent of CPE.

articleTitle: Remote Wavelength Tracking of Strongly Chirped Tunable 10G MEMS-VCSEL for Port-Agnostic WDM Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated the centralized wavelength control in a passive port-agnostic WDM fronthaul system for tracking a remotely tunable MEMS-VCSEL transceiver, which exhibited strong chirp due to the low-frequency pilot tone modulation.

articleTitle: Wideband Complexity-Enhanced Chaos Generation with Electro-Optic Phase Modulation and Dual Optical Feedback
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We numerically and experimentally demonstrated the generation flat-spectrum wideband chaos with efficient bandwidth of several tens of GHz and perfect time delay signature suppression using external-cavity semiconductor laser subject self-phase modulation and dual optical feedback.

articleTitle: Interoperable CFP-DCO and CFP2-DCO Pluggable Optic Interfaces for 100G WDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, interoperability is demonstrated at 100G with modern CFP-DCO and CFP2-DCO interfaces using the newly standardized Staircase FEC between three vendors and two DSP-ASIC providers. Inter-workable 100G WDM transmission (up to 1200 km) and passive point-to-point interconnection (up to 135 km) are shown.

articleTitle: A Compact 100G-ER4 ROSA Realized by Hybrid Integration of SOA and Lensed PIN-PDs for QSFP28 Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With hybrid integration of SOA and lensed PIN-PD chips on a silica-based AWG platform, we have developed a novel compact 100G-ER4 ROSA for QSFP28 transceivers with sensitivities below −27 dBm at a BER of 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>

articleTitle: Building Network Nervous System with Multilayer Telemetry to Realize AI-Assisted Reflexes in Software-Defined IP-Over-EONs for Application-Aware Service Provisioning
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate a network nervous system that can leverage multilayer telemetry to realize artificial intelligence (AI) assisted network reconfigurations (i.e., reflexes) in a software-defined IP over elastic optical network, for application-aware provisioning.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Software Solution to Support OpenConfig and OpenROADM
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A challenge facing vendors and service providers is the ability to support a growing number of device models with minimum cost and fast time to market. We demonstrate a software solution embracing diverse device models.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Effects of Angle-of-Arrival Fluctuation and Pointing Error on Airborne Free-Space Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an energy-efficient adaptive beam control technique, where beam sizes are adjusted without iterations at both transmitter and receiver using variable-focus lenses, to mitigate the performance degradation caused by angle-of-arrival fluctuations and pointing errors.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Soft-Assisted Product Decoders
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a 1-Tb/s 0.63-pJ/bit soft-assisted product decoder in a 28-nm technology. The decoder uses one bit of soft information to improve its net coding gain by 0.2 dB, reaching 10.3-10.4 dB, which is similar to that of more complex hard-decision staircase decoders.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Heterodyne Quantum Key Distribution in the S-Band Embedded in a Commercial DWDM System
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The tolerance of continuous-variable quantum key distribution to co-propagating DWDM channels is investigated. For the experiments, the quantum channel is operated in the S-band and multiplexed with a commercial C-band DWDM system. It is shown that compared to previously proposed configurations, the number of co-propagating channels can be doubled.

articleTitle: A 50Gb/s PAM-4 Retimer-CDR + VCSEL Driver with Asymmetric Pulsed Pre-Emphasis Integrated into a Single CMOS Die
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 50 Gb/s PAM-4 Retimer-CDR + VCSEL driver is fully-integrated in a 40nm CMOS process. Measurement results demonstrate wide optical eye openings using a 16GHz bandwidth VCSEL, achieving > 4 dB extinction ratio and < 8 pJ/bit energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Phase Insensitive High Order Mode Pass Filter with Low Reflection for Two-Mode Division Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> block TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> pass filter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated on SOI platform over C band. The filter suffers negligible reflection and is theoretically immune to phase dependent spectral fluctuation under dual-modes concurrent input.

articleTitle: Survivable VNF Placement and Scheduling with Multipath Protection in Elastic Optical Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a multipath protection-based virtual network function placement and scheduling scheme in elastic optical datacenter networks. It outperforms conventional protection methods in terms of spectrum and computing resource utilization as well as blocking probability.

articleTitle: Non-Orthogonal WDM Systems with Faster than Nyquist Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the concept of non-orthogonal WDM and review the principle of FTN. Performance comparison between FTN and constellation shaping is presented. Simulation results of FTN-CS-QAM are shown to support the evolution of 400G WDM.

articleTitle: Single-Channel Direct Detection Reception Beyond 1 Tb/s
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the world-first single-channel direct detection beyond 1-Tb/s with 1.26-Tb/s line rate and 1.02-Tb/s net rate after 100-km SSMF, via an 86-GHz Stokes vector receiver that recovers totally single-polarization-equivalent 252-Gbaud probabilistic-shaped 64-QAM signal.

articleTitle: Aluminum Nitride Ultralow Loss Waveguides and Push-Pull Electro-Optic Modulators for Near Infrared and Visible Integrated Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate ultralow loss AlN single-mode channel waveguide and AlN electro-optic (EO) modulators in CMOS compatible AlN-on-insulator photonic circuits. Propagation loss was measured to be ~0.42 dB/cm at 1550 nm and ~2.36 dB/cm at 905 nm. A push-pull MZI modulator with arm length of 2.8 cm exhibits V of ~21 V at 1550 nm and ~12.9 V at 1064 nm, and modulation speed of ~140 MHz, limited by the resistive-capacitive delay. A dual-ring modulator exhibits extension ratio of ~12 dB and high modulation speed of ~4 GHz because of its small footprint as compared with the MZI modulator.

articleTitle: Nonbinary Polar Coding for Multilevel Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate nonbinary polar-coded modulations, which achieve a significant performance gain of at least 1 dB compared to binary counterparts at a short block-length of 2048 bits.

articleTitle: Ultralow Loss Hollow-Core Conjoined-Tube Negative-Curvature Fiber for Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a hollow-core conjoined-tube negative-curvature fiber with unique merits of ultralow loss of 2 dB/km at telecom band and launch-insensitive response to the data transmission in 10-Gb/s OOK test.

articleTitle: MIMO Nonlinear Equalizer based on Inverse Volterra Series Transfer Function for Coherent SDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel MIMO Volterra-based nonlinear equalizer. Simulation results revealed a ~0.8 dB g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-factor improvement, after transmitting 6×32 Gbaud PM-16QAM signals carried by 6 spatial modes over 1,040 km of an FMF link.

articleTitle: Pilot Aided Compensation of Relative Phase Noise in Raman Amplified Coherent Transmission System with Forward Pumping
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate pilot aided compensation of Relative Phase Noise (RPN) in a forward pumped Raman amplified fiber system which effectively eliminates the error floor that arises when conventional phase noise compensation algorithms track RPN.

articleTitle: Long-Term Latency Measurement of Deployed Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a Correlation-OTDR we measured the latency of fibers in a deployed cable and calculated the time coefficient of the fiber temperature changes. Annual temperature variations of 25K were estimated for the deployed fiber.

articleTitle: Requirements of 5G Radio Networks on Optical X-Haul Transport
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper provides an insight as to the requirements imposed by 5G radio access networks (RAN) on optical fronthaul and midhaul transport.

articleTitle: Performance Estimation of Discrete Raman Amplification within Broadband Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The nonlinear impact of discrete Raman amplifiers on transmission in wideband systems is analyzed theoretically and tested experimentally. At double EDFA bandwidth, predicted reach of >3400km, indicates a distance penalty of ∼30% versus EDFA systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Rate Prefix-Free Code Distribution Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a multi-rate prefix-free code distribution matching (PCDM) algorithm that implements a fixed-length probabilistic constellation shaping. It uses various small codebooks in an adaptive manner, thereby improving the shaping performance of PCDM.

articleTitle: NFDMLab: Simulating Nonlinear Frequency Division Multiplexing in Python
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fiber-optic transmission based on nonlinear frequency division multiplexing (NFDM) has received much attention in recent years. We introduce NFDMLab, an open source software package for simulating NFDM transmissions written in the Python language.

articleTitle: Experimental Assessment of SDN-Enabled Reconfigurable OPSquare Data Center Networks with QoS Guarantees
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An SDN-controlled DCN enabling QoS-driven network-slice reconfiguration and packet priority updating is experimentally assessed. Network-slice can be reconfigured within 150 ms to decrease packet loss. The measured ToR-to-ToR latency of high-priority packets is 260.55 ns.

articleTitle: SVM-Modified-FFE Enabled Chirp Management for 10G DML-Based 50Gb/s/λ PAM4 IM-DD PON
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel machine learning based equalization algorithm for bandwidth-limited IM-DD PON in C-band. 50Gb/s/λ. PAM4 transmission is demonstrated over 20km SSMF using a 10G-class transmitter with 21dB loss budget without amplification.

articleTitle: Novel Hybrid Radio-Over-Fiber Transmitter for Generation of Flexible Combination of WDM-ROF/WDM Channels
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a transmitter capable of seamlessly generating any combination of WDM-ROF/WDM channels and demonstrate the highest WDM-ROF channel-number from a single laser-modulator pair with 100-km SSMF plus 0.5-m wireless transmission at 12×2.5-Gb/s and 10×4-Gb/s.

articleTitle: 56Gb/s PAM-4 VCSEL Transmitter with Quarter-Rate Forwarded Clock using 65nm CMOS Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 56Gb/s PAM-4 VCSEL transmitter is demonstrated in 65nm CMOS. This paper also discusses different kinds of clocking architecture.

articleTitle: 85°C Operation of Single-Mode 850 nm VCSELs for High Speed Error-Free Transmission up to 1 km in OM4 Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Single-mode 850 nm oxide-confined VCSELs with integrated mode-selective filter are developed. The fabricated devices have demonstrated 32 Gb/s (room temperature) & 26 Gb/s (85°C) error-free transmission over 500 m OM4 fiber, and 28 Gb/s (room temperature) & 22 Gb/s (85°C) over 1 km OM4 fiber.

articleTitle: Slice-Scaling Strategy Based on Representation Learning in Flex-Grid Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a slice-scaling strategy adapting to dynamic demands based on representation learning in flex-grid optical networks. Experiments show our strategy has lower latency than others when dealing with the slice-scaling problem.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Distributed Stress Sensor Based on Mode Coupling in Weakly-Coupled FMF
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a distributed stress sensing mechanism based on mode coupling in weakly-coupled FMF. The scheme is experimentally demonstrated over 5.27-km FMF with a spatial resolution of 13.9-m and a stress resolution of 0.046-kg/cm.

articleTitle: Narrow Linewidth InAs/InP Quantum Dot DFB Laser
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Narrow linewidth InAs/InP QD DFB lasers with linewidths of less than 50kHz at 20°C which broadens to less than 80kHz at 80°C were demonstrated using delayed self-heterodyne as well as by optical frequency comb interferometry.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Sub-Band Digital Back Propagation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose sub-band digital back propagation (DBP). We confirmed performance improvement by 4 sub-band DBP with 10-WDM 64-Gbaud 64QAM transmission over 840 km. Total FFT/IFFT size becomes approximately one quarter of full-band DBP.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Non-Linear Phase Noise Mitigation using a Modified Soft-Decoding Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a modified soft-decoding strategy that takes into account residual non-linear phase noise. We show the effectiveness of this method in a multi-span experiment with propagation over legacy fibers using uniform and probabilistic-shaped constellations.

articleTitle: Direct Measurement of Polarization Dependency of Mode Conversion in a Long Period Grating
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A thermal induced long period grating mode converter with high bandwidth, and low loss is presented. Polarization dependency of the mode conversion is measured using spatial and spectral (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) imaging and found to be low.

articleTitle: Routing without Routing Algorithms: An AI-Based Routing Paradigm for Multi-Domain Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first propose a novel multi-domain routing paradigm that transforms the routing problem from heuristic-algorithm-based computation to artificial-intelligence-based data analytics. Numerical results prove that our proposal can achieve excellent routing accuracy, and significant signaling reduction.

articleTitle: Optical Self-Heterodyne Generation of Dual-Band Linear Frequency Modulated Microwave Pulses
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photonic generation of dual-band chirped microwave pulses by self-heterodyne beat is presented. Six combinations of S, C, X and Ku bands were synthesized with 2,000-6,000 time-bandwidth products. Linear frequency modulation was verified for all bands.

articleTitle: Brillouin Optical Time Domain Analyzer Fiber Sensor Based on FPGA Accelerated Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Support vector regression and its FPGA implementation have been employed in a BOTDA system to extract temperature information. Post-processing of 96,100 BOTDA data points along 38.44-km fiber can be completed within 0.5 seconds.

articleTitle: Optimum Bit-Level Distribution Matching with at Most O(N3) Implementation Complexity
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An algorithm of distribution matching which could be effectively implemented for short block lengths of around 100 bit or less is proposed, enabling better performance than the constant composition schemes with the same block lengths.

articleTitle: Programmable Schemes on Temporal Processing of Optical Pulses for High-Speed Photonic Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Modulation-assisted temporal Talbot effect has given birth to different programmable schemes on temporal processing of optical pulses. In this paper, we review our recent work on developing such high-speed pulse processing schemes and their applications.

articleTitle: Receiver DSP Highly Tolerant to Transmitter IQ Impairments
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel DSP equalization structure providing high tolerance to transmitter IQ impairments is proposed. Two-fold tolerance improvement for gain and quadrature error, bias offsets and skew is demonstrated both numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Chromatic Dispersion Analysis and Compensation in a Large Core-Count Few-Mode Multi-Core Fiber Based on Optical Vector Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Chromatic dispersion in a large core-count 3-mode fiber is analyzed, observing up to 0.75 ps/(nm· km) variations between mode groups. Furthermore, digital CD compensation is shown to relax the stringent path length matching required in such systems.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Potential 130.8 Tb/s Capacity in Power-Efficient SDM Transmission over 12,700 km using Hybrid Micro-Assembly Based Amplifier Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate feasibility of power efficient full C-band 130.8 Tb/s SDM transmission over transoceanic distance using MCF and a compact amplifier platform. Power efficiency is improved by using modulation format with optimal spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Field Trial of Machine-Learning-Assisted and SDN-Based Optical Network Management
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we reported machine-learning based network dynamic abstraction over a field-trial testbed. The implemented network-scale NCMDB allows the ML-based quality-of-transmission predictor abstract dynamic link parameters for further network planning.

articleTitle: Electrically Driven Photonic Integrated Soliton Microcomb
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate via self-injection locking an electrically driven soliton micro-comb by coupling a multi-frequency laser diode to a chip-scale high-Q Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator. This approach offers a pathway for an integrated and ultra-compact microcomb source for high-volume applications e.g. coherent telecommunication and data-center interconnects.

articleTitle: Rail Crack Detection by Analyzing the Acoustic Transmission Process Based on Fiber Distributed Acoustic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A method for rail crack detection by analyzing sound wave generated by the interaction between wheel and crack is proposed. Field tests verify the feasibility with maximum locating error of 2.1m.

articleTitle: BER Improvement of IM/DD Higher-Order Optical PAM Signal with Precise Non-Linearity Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a precise Tx-side non-linear distortion compensation scheme for higher-order PAM signals, and experimentally show its effectiveness in 28 GBaud PAM-8 and 40 GBaud THP(Tomlinson Harashima Precoding)-PAM6 signals with more than 2-dB power budget improvement.

articleTitle: Mode-Multiplexed Transmission within and Across Mode Groups of a Multimode-Fiber
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show mode-multiplexed transmission over individual mode groups up to 9 groups of a 27 km long graded-index multimode fiber. We also investigate transmission distances up to 500 km using a recirculating loop arrangement for the first 6 mode groups using QPSK and 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Independent Turbulence Mitigation of Two 100-Gbit/s QPSK Orbital-Angular-Momentum Multiplexed Beams using Wavefront Shaping and Controlled Scattering
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate using wavefront shaping and controlled scattering to mitigate different-strength turbulence effects (D/r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 2.4,6.0) in a 200-Gbit/s orbital angular momentum (OAM)-multiplexed link.

articleTitle: Zero-Touch Provisioning of Distributed Video Analytics in a Software-Defined Metro-Haul Network with P4 Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate automated network service provisioning and virtual network function orchestration with P4-based VNF acceleration. Zero-touch provisioning of distributed computing resources at the edge and central office is validated with a video analytics use case.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a MultiVendor Path Computation with Optical Feasibility Combining GMPLS and Open Source
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Openness and interoperability are a challenge in optical networks, especially when it comes to lightpath optical performance estimation. We propose to use a vendor-agnostic open-source tool and extend the OSPF-TE protocol with the required parameters.

articleTitle: ODTN: Open Disaggregated Transport Network. Discovery and Control of a Disaggregated Optical Network through Open Source Software and Open APIs
publicationTitle: 2019 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: ONOS discovers and manages a topology made of Transponders and a dedicated OLS, using standard protocols (NETCONF/RESTCONF) and models (OpenConfig/TAPI). The demo is a joint collaboration, towards production deployment, between 3 operators and 2 equipment vendors.
